That night the beam swept the dark water as it always did, but he watched it longer than usual, wondering how many silent departures the ocean carried.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市是一座灰蓝色的梦境。路灯仍亮着，却已失去了与黑暗抗衡的意义，光晕在薄雾中洇开，像宣纸上不小心落下的淡墨。环卫工人的扫帚声从远处传来，有节奏地划破寂静，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，车灯在湿漉漉的柏油路面上拉出两道细长的光痕。早点铺的蒸笼刚刚架上灶台，白色的热气从铁皮屋顶升起，融进尚未退去的夜色里。这座城市最诚实的时刻，既不属于昨天，也还不属于今天，万物悬浮在将醒未醒之间。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem — like looking up a word in the dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a \"base case\" — a simple version of the problem it can answer immediately without calling itself again, so it doesn't keep going forever.\n• Imagine you're in a line of people and you want to know how many are behind you: you ask the person behind you, they ask the person behind them, and so on until the last person says \"zero\" — then each answer travels back up the line, adding one each time."}
